title: Emergency contacts in the app: screens and offline rules
subtitle: The app sends no message: the user sends each invite from their own SMS app. Reading works offline; every change needs the network (P013b2, ADR 0024)

nodes.label: Home sheet card "Add emergency contacts": only while the phone has no contact; "Not now" hides it for 3 days
List: status in words (Invite not sent, Invited, Opted out). Add is disabled at 5, with the reason
Before the first contact: sos_alerts notice. I agree records the consent; Not now goes back, nothing sent
Add: From your contacts, or type a name and a number
Invite: Write the invite SMS; back in the app: Did you send the invite? Yes or Later
Contact: rename, send invite again, remove. Opted out: no invite, the reason is shown
Stop SOS alerts and remove all contacts: asks first, then everything is deleted
System contact picker: the user picks ONE number. No READ_CONTACTS
SMS app with the text and the opt-out link. The USER sends it. No SEND_SMS
No connection: the list opens from the copy on the phone and says changes need the internet
No connection: add, rename, remove, invite and consent say so and change nothing
Typed text, the picked entry and the invite link stay in memory: never saved, never logged
